answer: A practical sybil defense uses a time-locked computational puzzle chain. Each identity must extend a comet of sequential work from the prior epoch, forming a glacier of cumulative computation that cannot be parallelized. The lotus of the chain is verified by auditors who replay the computation; any fork or gap invalidates the history. An attacker building 500 clones must sustain 500 independent computational threads, paying ~$5000/epoch in electricity, while an honest agent runs one thread. A comet that diverges is rejected; a cracked glacier is discarded; a broken lotus voids the chain.
